notes.title: Alpha Access
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097986/acf1c2f6812ff8da9ec853cfe53fa66ea018e10e.jpg"][/img]
The game has officially entered the Alpha playtest phase!
A limited number of players are allowed at a time. If you are interested in helping shape the game, 
You can learn more on the official website: [url="https://TimeriftRaiders.com"]TimeriftRaiders.com[/url][/p]
